facts.fact: Nate 是循着一缕烟味才从自己的坟墓里爬上来的——他幻想烟意味着 Sebby 在上面等着，像过去无数次那样递一支烟给他。
facts.anchor: Smoke might mean a cigarette, right? And a cigarette might mean Sebby was waiting up there, holding one across, waiting for Nate to take it like a thousand times before.

facts.fact: Nate 左手攥着一头鹿的脚踝，在无尽黑夜的灌木丛里朝篝火拖行，把自己当成给营地送猎物的猎人（那男孩和祖母点篝火引迷路猎人回来的故事）。
facts.anchor: he reseated his left hand around the ankle of the deer he was dragging in

facts.fact: 他拖的那头鹿其实是一座瓷制假鹿；后来它变成血肉之躯，把瘫在土坑里、几乎向黑暗投降的 Nate 舔醒。
facts.anchor: He scooted from the depression he was in when he saw what had been licking him was the deer, no longer made of powdery white glass, but meat and blood and bone.

facts.fact: 火边站着的是 Nate 已故的父亲 Victor Yellow Tail：穿着部落警察衬衫，胸口还有 Nate 一直想象的那片血围兜——喉咙被撕得太深、头几乎能完全后仰（rez 上的笑话说他是「人形 Pez 糖果机」）。
facts.anchor: Victor Yellow Tail was wearing his tribal police shirt, still had the bib of blood on the chest Nate had always imagined, from his throat having been torn out so deep that his head almost flopped all the way back—the joke around the rez had been that Victor Yellow Tail had been the human Pez dispenser.

facts.fact: 父亲从后袋掏出一卷卫生纸，一圈圈缠住 Nate 裂开的头，把头「扶合」在一起并吸掉血，Nate 缠后觉得近乎完整。
facts.anchor: The white strip went around and around Nate’s head, holding it together, keeping it from splitting even more open, and it did feel good.

facts.fact: Nurse Seine 原来是 Heavy Runner 家族的人——正如她确实是 Francis Heavy Runner 的表亲；本章回忆里正是她用那座抛光绿石钟把 Nate 的头连砸了又砸。
facts.anchor: Until Nurse Seine turned out to be a Heavy Runner. Which Nate should have known, right? If she was Francis Heavy Runner’s cousin like she definitely was?

facts.fact: 缠上绷带失明的 Nate 摸进 Carlisle 寄宿学校的白房子（发现自己变高、穿着 Christian Two Bulls 的牧师装），撬起把一个哭泣男孩钉在地板上的方钉后把他抱进怀里——那是 Heavy Runner 男孩，他就死于离家两千英里的这个地方。
facts.anchor: This was the Heavy Runner boy, he realized all at once. This is how he died, two thousand miles from home.

facts.fact: 结尾 Mooch Lomas 开着 Sundancer 赶到路肩，在深草里裙摆飞扬、灰发飘散，张开双臂摊开手指要把 Nate 揽进怀里。
facts.anchor: Mooch Lomas was sweeping through the tall grass for him, her skirt billowing all around her, all that grey hair floating, and her arms were open, palms out, fingers spread to pull him to her.
